option_a_notes: The dark palette and lime accents create a clear hierarchy, and the desktop hero headline breaks cleanly. The demo has readable time ticks and an explicit +84 ms label. The workflow and feature sections feel like grids of spec items, and the benchmark bars render as nearly identical slivers despite large differences in the labeled values. On mobile, the headline strands 「か。」 and the metrics wrap into an uneven two-plus-one layout.
option_b_notes: The desktop hero puts the install commands beside the trace comparison, and the terminal transcript connects the four workflow steps to a concrete regression. The trace visibly identifies itself as model data. The benchmark separates time from memory, shows the SaaS latency range, and distinguishes unavailable memory data from measured values. The mobile headline breaks cleanly, but both install commands wrap inside tokens. The desktop hero strands 「。」 on its own line, and several span labels truncate.
rationale: B makes the product easier to understand through the hero demo, worked terminal example, and benchmark encodings. Its desktop alignment, section rhythm, and mobile headline give it the stronger composition. Craft is a tie because both renders have conspicuous wrapping or truncation defects.
